title.zh: 有限接续充分性与分支方案
title.en: Finite continuation adequacy and branching plans

claim.zh: 给定转移、观察、目标与许可时，n 步 viable 等价于存在一个依观察分支且 works 的 n 步方案。
claim.en: For supplied transitions, observations, target and admissibility, n-step viable is equivalent to an observation-branching n-step plan satisfying works.

hypotheses.zh: 有限步数与现有 viable、Plan、works；观察分支的选择使用所列既有逻辑依赖。
hypotheses.en: Finite horizon and the existing viable, Plan and works; branch selection retains the recorded logical dependencies.

correspondence.zh: 模型中的许可不自动是伦理正当性；作用覆盖与观察校准另需根据。
correspondence.en: Model admissibility is not automatically ethical permission; effect coverage and observation calibration require warrant.

detail.zh: 一阶可共同采取的行动不保证第二步；所列盲观察例保留失败。
detail.en: A common first response need not support the second step; the blind-observation example retains the failure.

detail.zh: 对任意登记，每个被保持之类在每个进程中都有方案，恰是对登记的选择（plans_iff_choice）：外围 viable_iff_plan 的 choose 在一般情形不能去掉；登记可列举时不需要（keptFor_iff_plan）。
detail.en: For arbitrary registrations, kept classes having plans in every process is exactly choice over the registrations (plans_iff_choice): the periphery’s choose in viable_iff_plan cannot be dropped in general, and is not needed where registrations are listed (keptFor_iff_plan).

limitations.zh: 一阶可共同采取的行动不保证第二步；所列盲观察例保留失败。
limitations.en: A common first response need not support the second step; the blind-observation example retains the failure.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 复用有限方案接口；无限接续和实际取得足够观察仍单独研究。
next_delta.en: Reuse the finite-plan interface; infinite continuation and actual acquisition of sufficient observation remain separate.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.

history.zh: 2026-10-15，整合 I3c（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述（新核心模块 Becoming.Keeping）。一步可用于一个配置类，指它在每个配置处都被容许且可走（Usable）；该步所登记者使类收窄（Seen，登记可列举时即 InquirySufficiency.After）。一类保持 n 步，指守卫遍及该类，且有某个可用之步无论登记什么都留下保持少一步的类（KeptFor）。依所登记者给出后续之步的方案保持该类其长度之久，不加前提（Plan.Keeps.keptFor）；登记可列举时每个被保持之类都有这样的方案，不加前提（keptFor_iff_plan）；对任意登记，这恰是对登记的选择（plans_iff_choice，选择为具名假设 ChoiceOver）。更细的登记保持更粗的登记所保持者（KeptFor.finer）；Viability 的证书在其中有一步处处可用时使其中每类对每个时程都被保持（Certificate.keptFor、Kernel.keptFor）；登记一个隐藏的位可决定保持与否（Matching.registration_matters）。外围实例：ContinuationAdequacy 的 viable 即以到达的配置为登记的 KeptFor（ContinuationCorrespondence.viable_iff_keptFor），方案两向互译（works_iff_keeps、keeps_iff_works），故 viable_iff_plan 由核心律与 Classical.choice 给出（viable_iff_plan_by_core），观察可列举时不用公理（viable_iff_plan_listed）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。Becoming.Keeping 由核心运行审计（回执 20261015T150956.178111Z，公理报告为空）；外围实例模块 ContinuationCorrespondence 由其检查器以 Lean 4.30.0-rc2 与 Mathlib 实查（回执 20261015T151901.978501Z）：单一方案的对应与可列举的情形公理报告为空，Classical.choice 只在 classicalChoice 与 viable_iff_plan_by_core 中，共同方案的几条用 propext 与 Quot.sound。
history.en: 15 October 2026, integration I3c (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (new core module Becoming.Keeping). A move is usable from a class of configurations where it is allowed and enabled at each of them (Usable), and what its step registers narrows the class (Seen, which is InquirySufficiency.After where registrations are listed). A class is kept for n steps where the guard holds throughout and some usable move leaves, whatever is registered, a class kept one step fewer (KeptFor). A plan whose later moves follow what was registered keeps the class for its length, with no premise (Plan.Keeps.keptFor); where registrations are listed every kept class has such a plan, with no premise (keptFor_iff_plan); for arbitrary registrations that is exactly choice over the registrations (plans_iff_choice, choice the named hypothesis ChoiceOver). A finer registration keeps what a coarser one keeps (KeptFor.finer); a certificate of Viability with a move usable throughout keeps every class within it for every horizon (Certificate.keptFor, Kernel.keptFor); registering a hidden bit can decide keeping (Matching.registration_matters). Periphery instance: ContinuationAdequacy’s viable is KeptFor with the configuration reached registered (ContinuationCorrespondence.viable_iff_keptFor), plans translate both ways (works_iff_keeps, keeps_iff_works), so viable_iff_plan follows from the core law with Classical.choice (viable_iff_plan_by_core), and with no axiom for listed observations (viable_iff_plan_listed). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope. Becoming.Keeping is audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T150956.178111Z, empty axiom reports); the periphery instance module ContinuationCorrespondence is checked by its own checker with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and Mathlib (receipt 20261015T151901.978501Z): the single-plan correspondence and the listed case have empty axiom reports, Classical.choice occurs only in classicalChoice and viable_iff_plan_by_core, and the joint-plan declarations use propext and Quot.sound.
